text:
zoe: quick flag - onboarded ptq-gulliver v1 (int8) failing structured-toolcall checks in our acceptance harness. parse-fail ~1.6% vs fp16 0.2%.
arthur: any raw snippets?
zoe: paste from failing sample: 
```
{
  "task": "assign_label",
  "data": [ {"id": 77, "labels": ["bug","p1",], } ]
}
```
nina: trailing comma + extra brace pattern again. streaming or non-streaming?
zoe: mostly streaming shards where the stream ends mid-array. non-streaming shows surplus nulls occasionally.
arthur: could be kvcache warmstart + small batch combo. what's canary config?
zoe: `--canary=ptq-gulliver:1% --batch=6 --kv-warmup=0.05s --max-toks=384`.
arthur: try bumping kv-warmup to 0.4s in a replay. also run a token-diff between int8 and fp16 to see if comma token frequency increases.
staging-bot: replay launched -> run-1805000001-replay-1
zoe: microbench numbers: fp16 parse-fail 0.18%, ptq-int8 1.62%. token-diff shows extra comma tokens around suffix in ~35% of failed cases.
nina: interim mitigation: enable mirror-only postprocess that strips trailing commas and removes empty final array elements. tag telemetry `soft_clean=v0` so we can measure semantics changes.
arthur: agreed but keep it mirror-only and gate rollout. add onboarding rule: fail if int8 increases parse-fail >0.5% abs.
staging-bot: mirror run complete -> parse-fail 0.28%; soft_clean applied 1.8% of responses; semantics_changed 0.02%
zoe: good improvement. i'll raise ticket for kernel-decoder investigation; need to know whether rounding in logit ops yields comma amplification.
arthur: i'll add a nightly check comparing punctuation token distributions across quant kernels. nina: can you land the soft_clean PR and the onboarding gate?
nina: PR opened, linking slack alert to eng-ml for failures.
zoe: summary: root likely quant-decoder token noise at suffix + kvcache warmstart effects. mitigations: kv-warmup tuning, mirror-only soft_clean, onboarding gate. next: kernel deep-dive and 250-sample semantic audit if semantics_changed >0.01%.
arthur: thanks. ending thread, will follow in the kernel ticket. :thumbsup:
